items.description: Opponent-adjusted rating (def_db_epa): the team's defensive coefficient from the weighted ridge in nfl_edge.research.team_ratings.solve_ratings: y = league mean + off_team + def_opponent + hfa, recency half-life 10 weeks, prior-season carry 0.6, ridge 4.0, a 3-season window and only games strictly before the packet week; a deviation from the league mean of the windowed sample. Defensive ratings are what the defence allows above average: lower is better.
known_limitations: current snapshot only; no committed history
the ridge ratings have a point-in-time test but no accuracy or stability test
home-field advantage is one league-wide scalar; no standard error is reported; early-season ratings are dominated by prior seasons

items.description: Mean EPA allowed per defensive play (lower is better), averaged over the window's team-games: SEASON = the basis season's games, L6 = the last 6, L34 = the last 34 across seasons (games strictly before the packet week). Raw and unadjusted: it describes what happened, not how good the team is.
known_limitations: current snapshot only; no committed history
raw splits are null below 4 games (MIN_GAMES); the recent split is fixed at the last 6 games and the long baseline at the last 34
the silver team_game table is rebuilt every run from nflverse and is not committed
